scope: Bounded read-only static review of the pinned R6 assembler recipe. The recipe was inspected as source only; it was not executed and no source, test, harness, build, Git, model, UI, network, lease or product path was modified.

exact_edit_operations.guard: scoped AST walk, direct Raise nodes only, cause is None, one-line nodes, insertion at UTF-8 byte end offset, exactly 29 edits
scoped AST call walk, first argument is exactly Name(exc), source slice is exactly b"exc", exactly 48 edits
scoped AST subscript walk, exactly one literal b"inventory" source slice, exactly 1 edit

evidence: Production/test inputs are read with read_bytes.
byte_offsets accumulates byte lengths from splitlines(keepends=True).
AST lineno/end_lineno and col_offset/end_col_offset are translated to byte offsets, valid for Python UTF-8 source.
Each replacement is applied to non-overlapping sorted byte ranges and the resulting bytes are reparsed with ast.parse.

counts.status: PASS: exact assertions are present before any output write.

evidence: Pinned R5 production/test hashes are asserted before transformation.
apply_edits emits untouched byte segments directly from the original bytes and records each preserved segment size/hash.
Only the three declared edit streams plus the one new test append are assembled.
Outputs are reparsed and must end with exactly one terminal LF.
The returned Python block must parse to exactly one top-level FunctionDef named test_private_errors_suppress_outer_exception_context.
The function body is appended once after the preserved test source; duplicate top-level names are rejected before append.
The result JSON must report actual_exit_code == 0.
The result stdout object must exactly equal a fresh size/SHA pin of grok-foundation-r6.stdout.log.
The stdout must end with the required Tests not run. sentence and contain exactly one JSON fenced block and one Python fenced block.
All three R6 assembly outputs are checked absent before writing.
Both source outputs use open("xb") and the record uses open("x"), so existing output cannot be overwritten.
No path under src/video_paper_wiki or tests/unit is opened for write.

pin_and_safety_checks.recording: assembly-r6.json records fresh result/stdout/assembler/input/output pins, edit records, preserved segments, new-test size/SHA, product_source_written=false and accepted=false.

nonblocking_observation: The static guard verifies the new test name and no decorator but does not independently assert its parameter list; the required one-test stdout recipe and the subsequent focused preview remain the appropriate checks for the resources fixture parameter. This does not broaden or invalidate the exact three-edit assembly guard.
conclusion: GO is limited to executing this exact pinned recipe after the separately authorized R6 result/stdout exist. It does not accept the candidate, write product source paths, or authorize tests/build/model/Git actions beyond the recipe’s exclusive preview artifact assembly.
